project.description: The name of the project to initialize.

x-prompt.message: Which components would you like to add? (Press space to select, enter to confirm)

items.label: Button - Displays a button or a component that looks like a button
Card - Displays a card with header, content, and footer
Input - Displays a form input field
Label - Renders an accessible label associated with controls
Checkbox - A control that allows toggling between checked and not checked
Select - Displays a list of options for the user to pick from
Dialog - A window overlaid on the primary window
Toast - A succinct message that is displayed temporarily
Dropdown Menu - Displays a menu when triggered
Tabs - A set of layered sections of content
Table - A responsive table component
Avatar - An image element with a fallback for representing the user
Badge - Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge
Alert - Displays a callout for user attention
Tooltip - A popup that displays information related to an element
Progress - Displays an indicator showing the completion progress
Skeleton - Use to show a placeholder while content is loading
Separator - Visually or semantically separates content
Switch - A control that allows toggling between checked and not checked
Textarea - Displays a form textarea
Accordion - A vertically stacked set of interactive headings
Sheet - Extends the Dialog component to display complementary content
Popover - Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button
Calendar - A date field component for entering and editing dates
Command - Fast, composable, unstyled command menu
Form - Building forms with validation
Sidebar - A composable, themeable and customizable sidebar
Spinner - Loading indicator animations
